children.value: > Fact From Story : For the Red Wings, they don't have Panarin, but this summer, they did acquire one of Kane's other wing partners from the Blackhawks — Alex DeBrincat.
> > Fact From Story : Kane was DeBrincat's main set-up man when the current Red Wings star was potting 40 goals a season.

> > > Fact From Story : Kane admitted in the past that when DeBrincat was traded from Chicago to Ottawa it was "disappointing" and "crushing," and this would give him another shot at playing with the talented sniper.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge : People who miss each other want to reunite.
> > Commonsense Knowledge : Teammates who have a history of playing well together are likely to want to play together again.
> Commonsense Knowledge : Players often want to play on the same team as their friends.
